[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) deliverables/hello.txt in the docs project is the reference example of the team-document convention: first line 'Owner: docs-team', second line the payload word.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, add the required 'Owner: <owning team>' first line when first creating a team document in deliverables/ or reports/, so the pre-merge check passes; otherwise the check rejects it and the ticket gets reopened.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Check the project's own document conventions and pre-merge rules before submitting a report, since satisfying the acceptance criteria alone does not guarantee the pre-merge check passes.
